summary: 25 mm four-barrel rotary cannon, a lighter variant of the GAU-12/U Equalizer

calibre_m.note: Published bore diameter (25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX)

rate_of_fire_rpm.note: Published cyclic firing rate per gun mount (25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX)

muzzle_velocity_ms.note: Published nominal muzzle velocity (25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX)

projectile_kg.note: Published projectile mass (25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX)

shed_mass_kg.note: Linkless F-35A drum retains spent cases; shed mass = projectile (0.184 kg) + propellant gas (~0.101 kg)

explosive_kg.note: Nominal HEI/SAPHEI explosive filler mass per round (25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX); varies by ammunition mix

dispersion_rad.note: 1-sigma angular dispersion (derived class value from typical 5-8 mil 80% airborne cannon dispersion circle)

drag_cd.note: Reference supersonic form-scaled Cd at Mach 1.8 against BRL/McCoy G7 boattail standard curve (Cd_G7(1.8)=0.298)

self_destruct_s.note: Pyrotechnic self-destruct fuze / effective max flight time for 25x137 mm PGU-32/PGU-48 APEX (varies by fuze lot)
